issues.title: Architecture overview & research reference
issues.original_body:
# Choff — architecture overview & research reference

**Blau** is a native iOS app for long-form voice conversation with Grok. Everything is Swift / SwiftUI / SwiftData. Speech-to-text and voice ID run on device. Grok's realtime voice API generates the replies and the speech. All text is stored on device and synced through the user's private iCloud container.

> This issue is the source of truth for architecture decisions. Each epic links back here and carries the research for its area.

## Pipeline

```
Mic ─▶ AVAudioEngine (VPIO: echo cancel + noise suppression + AGC) ─▶ 16 kHz mono ring buffer
   ├─▶ Silero VAD (FluidAudio) ── speechStart / speechEnd
   ├─▶ Voice ID gate (WeSpeaker ResNet34-LM embedding, cosine + AS-norm vs enrolled centroid)
   │        accept / reject / uncertain  ──┐
   └─▶ Streaming ASR (Parakeet realtime EOU 120M @320 ms, FluidAudio) ── partials, EOU
                                           ▼
                 Utterance committer (only enrolled-speaker, final text; 2nd-pass TDT v3 for punctuation)
                                           ▼
   Grok realtime WS (turn_detection = null; text in ─▶ audio + transcript out; client tools)
                                           ▼
   AVAudioPlayerNode (24 kHz PCM16) ◀── barge-in: flush + response.cancel + item.truncate
                                           ▼
   SwiftData (CloudKit private DB) ─▶ Topic segmenter (TextTiling depth + hysteresis + on-device LLM confirm/label)
                                   └▶ Memory indexer (EmbeddingGemma 256-d int8 + FTS5, local-only) ─▶ search_memory tool
```

## Key decisions
| Area | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Project | XcodeGen `project.yml`; app target + local SPM package `BlauKit` with one module per subsystem | Deterministic project files, fast unit tests, clean boundaries |
| Min OS | iOS 26.0 (iOS 27 features behind `#available`) | SpeechAnalyzer fallback, Foundation Models, Liquid Glass toolbar |
| LLM / voice | xAI Grok realtime `wss://api.x.ai/v1/realtime`, model pinned (currently `grok-voice-think-fast-2.0`) | Speech-to-speech with tool calling. OpenAI Realtime–compatible events |
| Turn control | `turn_detection: null`. The client commits **text** of verified utterances | Only the enrolled speaker reaches the LLM. Manual sessions are billed for audio actually exchanged, not session time |
| Auth | **No backend.** The user's xAI API key lives in the Keychain (synced via iCloud Keychain). The app mints a short-lived client secret on device (`POST /v1/realtime/client_secrets`) and opens the WS with subprotocol `xai-client-secret.<token>` | No server to run and no key in the binary. `URLSessionWebSocketTask` strips `Authorization` on the WS upgrade |
| ASR | FluidAudio `StreamingEouAsrManager` (Parakeet realtime EOU 120M, 320 ms chunks); 2nd pass Parakeet TDT v3; Apple `SpeechTranscriber` fallback | Low latency on the Neural Engine, built-in end-of-utterance detection, punctuation from the second pass |
| Voice ID | WeSpeaker ResNet34-LM (FluidAudio CoreML, 256-d), 3–5 enrollment clips, cosine + AS-norm, accept/reject/uncertain with speculative ASR | Best maturity-to-size ratio on iOS; segment-level gating is practical today |
| Topics | Streaming TextTiling-style depth score over exchange embeddings + hysteresis. Candidate boundaries confirmed and titled by Foundation Models `@Generable` (≤5-word title) | Cheap, runs on device, doesn't flap; the LLM only sees candidate windows (4k-token context limit) |
| Memory | Pinned ProfileBlock + add-only temporal facts (Mem0/Zep ideas) + hybrid BM25 (FTS5) + vector (EmbeddingGemma 256-d int8, brute-force Accelerate) with RRF; exposed to Grok as tools | Closest to current SOTA (LongMemEval / LoCoMo) that is practical on device at personal scale |
| Storage | SwiftData + CloudKit private DB `iCloud.com.joeblau.choff` for **text and the voiceprint**. Vectors / FTS are local-only and rebuildable | Syncs across the user's devices; embeddings are large and tied to a model version |
| Perf | `OSSignposter` per stage, MetricKit, XCTest perf metrics, debug HUD, thermal-adaptive policy, 1 h soak test | Built in from day one |

## Module map (`BlauKit` local package)
- `BlauCore`: shared types (Utterance, Speaker, TimeRange), protocols, clock, feature flags
- `BlauTelemetry`: Logger categories, signposts, MetricKit, perf HUD model
- `BlauAudio`: AVAudioSession / engine, capture fan-out, playback, resampling
- `BlauTranscription`: VAD, streaming ASR, 2nd pass, SpeechAnalyzer fallback, model manager
- `BlauVoiceID`: embeddings, enrollment, verification gate, LID
- `BlauRealtime`: xAI WS client, event codables, session orchestration, tools
- `BlauPersistence`: SwiftData schemas, migrations, ModelActors
- `BlauTopics`: segmentation engine, labeling
- `BlauMemory`: embeddings, index, hybrid retrieval, extraction, tools
- App target `Blau`: SwiftUI views, composition root

## Product decisions (confirmed 2026-10-07)
1. **Timeline:** opens on the current topic with bullets above the fold. Older topics stay **compressed** (one row each) until tapped. Swipe down for history; swipe back or tap Now to return (#56, #58).
2. **Voiceprint syncs via iCloud** with the rest of the user's data, so enrolling once works on every device (#19, #46).
3. **No backend.** The app talks to xAI directly with the user's API key from the Keychain and mints ephemeral realtime tokens on device (#33). A token proxy is only needed if Blau ships publicly on a shared xAI account.

## Research briefs (Oct 2026)
<details><summary>xAI Grok Voice API</summary>

- WS `wss://api.x.ai/v1/realtime?model=…`. Ephemeral tokens via `POST /v1/realtime/client_secrets` (default 600 s, max 3600 s).
- Events mirror OpenAI Realtime GA: `session.update`, `input_audio_buffer.*`, `conversation.item.create/truncate`, `response.create/cancel`, `response.output_audio.delta`, `response.output_audio_transcript.delta`, `response.function_call_arguments.done`, `response.done`.
- Audio pcm/pcmu/pcma/opus, 8–48 kHz (default 24 kHz PCM16). JSON or binary transport.
- `turn_detection: null` gives manual turns. Text input supported.
- Tools: `function`, `web_search`, `x_search`, `file_search`, `mcp`.
- Max session 120 min; `resumption` reconnects with `?conversation_id=` (history kept 30 min).
- Pricing: $0.08/min S2S, $0.004/text input.
- Voices: eve (default), ara, rex, sal, leo, … (`GET /v1/tts/voices`).
- Swift sample: xai-org/xai-cookbook `examples/voice-agent-mobile/swift`.
- Docs: https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/audio/speech-to-speech · https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/audio/ephemeral-tokens · https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing
</details>
<details><summary>Parakeet ASR on iOS</summary>

- FluidAudio ≥0.17.5 (Apache-2.0, iOS 17+). `StreamingEouAsrManager(chunkSize: .ms320, eouDebounceMs:)`: partial callback, EOU callback, token timestamps.
- Call `finish()` per EOU: token history grows unbounded otherwise.
- Models on HF `FluidInference/parakeet-realtime-eou-120m-coreml` (~225 MB) and `parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-coreml` (~480 MB), downloaded at runtime.
- Silero VAD v6 CoreML via `VadManager`.
- iOS 27 restricts background Neural Engine access (`com.apple.developer.background-tasks.continued-processing.inference`), so test screen-locked and keep a CPU fallback.
- Fallback: `SpeechAnalyzer` + `SpeechTranscriber` (iOS 26).
- https://github.com/FluidInference/FluidAudio
</details>
<details><summary>Voice ID</summary>

- WeSpeaker ResNet34-LM (0.72% EER Vox1-O, ~25 MB CoreML, 256-d) via FluidAudio / speech-swift. CAM++ as challenger.
- Enrollment: 3–5 × 3–6 s clips, centroid plus individual embeddings.
- Short segments degrade badly (2.4% EER at 3 s, 18.4% at 1 s), so score at 1.5 s and re-score at 3 s.
- Cosine 0.5–0.7 is the expected range; calibrate on recordings. AS-norm against a bundled ~1k impostor cohort.
- Adaptive update with a drift cap.
- PersonalVAD / VoiceFilter-Lite are closed; FireRedChat-pVAD (ONNX) is a later option.
- LID: ECAPA VoxLingua107.
- Noise: VPIO; DeepFilterNet3 CoreML (4 MB) for the ASR path.
</details>
<details><summary>Semantic memory</summary>

- SOTA ideas: Mem0 (add-only fact extraction + hybrid retrieval), Zep/Graphiti (validity-dated facts), Letta (pinned memory blocks + sleep-time consolidation), Mastra Observational Memory, LongMemEval guidance (exchange-level chunks, fact-augmented keys, time-aware queries).
- On device: EmbeddingGemma-300M (Matryoshka 256-d), FTS5 BM25 + int8 vectors brute-force with Accelerate, RRF fusion.
- USearch HNSW only past ~200k vectors. Optional iOS 27 `SpotlightSearchTool`.
</details>
<details><summary>Topic segmentation & iOS infra</summary>

- TextTiling depth + hysteresis (min topic 60 s / 4 exchanges, 30 s cooldown). Foundation Models `@Generable` confirm + title (4,096-token context).
- TreeSeg for offline re-segmentation.
- SwiftData + CloudKit rules: all properties optional or defaulted, no `.unique`, optional relationships with inverses, no `.deny`, additive-only production schema. Flat models (inheritance + CloudKit still buggy).
- SwiftUI: `defaultScrollAnchor(.bottom)`, `onScrollGeometryChange`, no inverted ScrollView; iOS 27 prepend scroll regression FB24968838.
- Toolbar: `.bottomBar` items + `ToolbarSpacer`.
</details>

issues.title: Epic: Full-duplex audio pipeline
issues.original_body:
Run capture and playback at the same time for hour-long sessions: AVAudioSession `.playAndRecord` / `.voiceChat`, voice-processing IO (echo cancellation, noise suppression, AGC), a capture fan-out to VAD / ASR / voice ID, a streaming PCM player with barge-in flush, and robustness to interruptions, route changes and backgrounding.

**Research notes:** call `inputNode.setVoiceProcessingEnabled(true)` before the engine starts. `setPreferredIOBufferDuration(0.01–0.02)`. Handle `interruptionNotification` (`.shouldResume`), `routeChangeNotification`, `AVAudioEngineConfigurationChange`, `mediaServicesWereResetNotification`. Background mode `audio`.

Architecture & research: #1

issues.title: Epic: Voice ID — respond only to the enrolled speaker
issues.original_body:
Only the enrolled user's speech reaches the LLM. Background noise, TV, other people and other languages are ignored.

**Research:** WeSpeaker ResNet34-LM embeddings (FluidAudio CoreML, 256-d, 0.72% EER), 3–5 enrollment clips, cosine + AS-norm, score at 1.5 s and re-score at 3 s, accept/reject/uncertain, speculative ASR commit/discard, adaptive centroid with drift cap, ECAPA VoxLingua107 LID, VPIO + optional DeepFilterNet3.

Architecture & research: #1

- [ ] #46 Build voice enrollment: guided capture, voiceprint profile and secure storage
- [x] #47 Build the verification gate: accept, reject or uncertain per speech segment with speculative ASR
- [x] #48 Build the voice ID evaluation harness and threshold calibration

Connect to the xAI Grok realtime voice API: ephemeral-token auth, a typed WebSocket client, manual turn control with text input and audio output, barge-in, function calling, and session continuity past the 120-minute limit.

issues.title: Epic: SwiftData models & iCloud container sync
issues.original_body:
Store all text (conversations, utterances, topics, knowledge, facts) in SwiftData, mirrored to the user's private CloudKit database in `iCloud.com.joeblau.blau`. Use versioned schemas and migrations, and keep derived indexes local-only.

**Research:** CloudKit rules: all properties optional/defaulted, no `.unique`, optional relationships with inverses, no `.deny`, additive-only prod schema. Avoid `@Model` inheritance (CloudKit crash reports). Use `VersionedSchema` + `SchemaMigrationPlan` from v1.

Architecture & research: #1

issues.title: Epic: Automatic topic switching & labeling
issues.original_body:
Watch the conversation as it streams, detect when the topic changes, start a new topic, and give each topic a short auto-generated label.

**Research:** TextTiling depth over exchange embeddings + hysteresis (≥60 s / 4 exchanges per topic, 30 s cooldown, retroactive boundary at the deepest dip). Candidates are confirmed and titled by Foundation Models `@Generable TopicShift`. Provisional title → refined on close. TreeSeg offline re-segmentation.
